fact_text: Making one tonne of caustic soda consumes roughly 25,000 kWh of electricity, so power is the single largest cost input in production.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because power is such a large share of cost, a small change in the per-unit electricity tariff moves profit per tonne by a large proportion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Profit per tonne is the selling price minus production cost, so the electricity cost per unit is the main lever an owner should track.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Producers with their own captive power plants gain a cost edge over those buying grid electricity, because grid power is expensive relative to what this industry can absorb.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Margins are expected to hold because the industry combines import protection with access to locally produced, lower-cost electricity.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Common salt, the brine feedstock, is easily available in Pakistan and is essential to the process, but its share of total cost is small.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda is corrosive, so transport and storage need special containers and safety protocols, which add cost to imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Logistics costs and import duties can lift the landed cost of imported caustic soda well above its international price.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Captive coal-fired power costs move with global coal prices, so a coal-based producer's electricity cost is exposed to coal price swings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda (sodium hydroxide) is produced by electrolysing brine, which also yields chlorine and hydrogen as co-products.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda is a strong alkali: it neutralises acids and breaks down grease and oil, which is why it is used in bleaching, soap making and pulp processing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Textile processing is the largest end use of caustic soda in Pakistan, and the textile sector is its main buyer.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Soaps and detergents are a second major use of caustic soda, which links its demand to the FMCG sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pulp and paper production is a further end use for caustic soda.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda demand rises with textile exports, because more export processing means more bleaching, finishing and dyeing volume.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda is classed as a hazardous chemical, so port handling and import rules are strict, which creates non-tariff barriers to imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Customs duties on imported caustic soda, plus a specific duty on liquid imports, protect local producers against cheaper foreign supply.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Import substitution is strong in caustic soda, leaving domestic suppliers in a comfortable position.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan exports only caustic soda in flake form, since exporting the liquid is operationally risky and costly.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Government policy to rationalise industrial energy tariffs and support export sectors indirectly lifts the caustic soda industry.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government's incremental electricity package is cutting industrial power tariffs after a long gap, which benefits energy-intensive chemical makers.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When oil prices spike, many chemicals get dearer, but chemicals whose main input is electricity rather than oil see a smaller rise in production cost and are hit less.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda is cyclical and volatile, and producer profitability depends on how well local players manage power costs and local pricing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees caustic soda as a high-value industry where energy efficiency, industrial demand and import barriers together support profitability.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda supply is concentrated, with three listed producers holding the large majority of the market.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sitara Chemicals is the largest caustic soda producer by capacity among the three main listed players.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Ittehad Chemicals ranks second by caustic soda capacity, behind Sitara Chemicals.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Engro Polymer & Chemicals is the third-largest caustic soda producer among the main players.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: For Engro Polymer & Chemicals, caustic soda is a small part of the business, whose main activity is PVC production.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Nimir Chemicals has started its own caustic soda production, which is consumed mostly internally in its noodle business.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sitara Chemicals commissioned a 50 MW coal-fired captive power plant in August 2025, and it became operational in February 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Sitara coal plant was a roughly PKR 10 billion investment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst estimates Sitara's coal plant could generate roughly 350-400 million units a year at a cost below grid power.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The captive power investment is justified by the saving against grid electricity, which the analyst expects to recover the investment over time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sitara Chemicals reported FY25 profit of about PKR 44 per share, roughly PKR 1 billion in total.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lower energy cost flows directly into Sitara's gross margin, which is the analyst's main thesis for the stock.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY27 scenario for Sitara has revenue of about PKR 33-34 billion and gross margin of 27-29%, as coal power lowers cost of sales.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The same FY27 scenario gives Sitara operating profit of about PKR 7-8 billion and net profit of PKR 3-3.5 billion; these are assumption-based and could differ materially.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Ittehad Chemicals benefits from the incremental electricity package because cheaper grid power lowers its cost base.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Ittehad has announced a biomass power plant, planned for commissioning by the end of FY27.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Biomass power can be cheaper than coal and much cheaper than gas, so Ittehad's biomass plant could lower its production cost once running.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Ittehad's cost advantage is expected to come in two stages: first from the electricity package, then from biomass power from mid-to-late 2027.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Ittehad's caustic flake expansion adds about 15,000 tonnes a year of capacity, aimed largely at export markets.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because caustic flake is mainly exported, Ittehad can use the extra capacity to earn additional export revenue.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's FY27 scenario for Ittehad has total revenue of about PKR 34-35 billion and gross margin of 18-19%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The same FY27 scenario gives Ittehad operating profit of PKR 3.5-4.5 billion and net profit of about PKR 2 billion; these are assumption-based.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's core thesis is that energy transformation at Sitara and Ittehad, through captive coal and biomass power, can reset profitability for the whole industry.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A producer that adopts an efficient power source moves lower on the cost curve and keeps profitability even in the low-price phases of the cycle.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Local caustic soda prices are expected to remain stable, because local demand is consistent and imports stay expensive.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sharp falls in local caustic soda prices are unlikely while demand is growing and the economy expands.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees caustic soda entering its next growth phase, with stable demand, disciplined supply, strong import barriers and majors modernising cost structures, though the sector stays cyclical.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues the sector should be understood through its business economics and structure, not through short-term price swings or global speculation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's chlor-alkali plants started around 1980, when local demand was limited and the technology was less efficient.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Caustic soda demand grew steadily as the textile and FMCG sectors expanded, while energy dependence and import protection stayed constant features of the industry.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst argues that PSX history shows investing during oil-shock market corrections has produced good results over the following years, though no outcome is guaranteed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Stock markets usually price in events about four to six months before they happen, so expectations for new plant commissioning can show up early.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'The Hidden Industry Behind Textiles & Detergents. Caustic Soda Industry Explained' (YouTube transcript, undated)
